authority: #K2-226 JIA stage: single-source rules + complete 16/16 dimension table incl. final leg; zero construction runs; enforced gate

rules.R1_stage_rows: cut the tail vertical span [Y..H] at the machine-verified FULL-SPAN rows (cols 61..114 free on layer 0); always include H-1 and Y
rules.R2_bisect: if a stage's needed span > available contiguous free run on every candidate column, bisect it (mid = a - ceil(need/2)) and recurse (R580 law)
rules.R3_column_by_exit: order candidate columns by |c - exit_column|; take the first column satisfying BOTH the horizontal run on the cut row and the vertical run inside the stage (R582 law)
rules.R4_final_leg: the LAST stage's column is restricted: EAST group -> cols >=115 (wall-east, so the lane lands east of the wall at row 36 and the final run to (exitc,36) is short); WEST group -> cols <=113 then the final run to (114,exit_row); the final run is dimensioned like any stage: available >= needed
rules.R5_no_trial: columns/bands are DERIVED by R1-R4; trying +/-N to make it pass is forbidden
rules.R6_enforced_gate: this script refuses to emit a complete verdict if any lane fails dimensioning (fail-closed)

buildability.note: route uses only free in-register cells; no registered object moved; NO construction run in this stage
